Name: TC_DASHBOARD_VIEW_002(positive/responsiveness): Verify dashboard layout grids resize and scale proportionally on tablet screens
Precondition:
Pre-conditions:
1. Use Google Chrome with active developer console access.
2. Administrator credentials are authenticated, and the landing
dashboard view is active.
3. Browser Developer Tools window is toggled into screen emulation mode
.

Requirements:

* TC_AUTH_LOGIN_004(Positive): Verify successful login with valid admin
credentials.
Objective:
This test case verifies that dashboard widgets, layout tracking cards, and
tabular tracking information adapt their multi-column structures down
fluidly when viewed through standard tablet viewport resolutions.
Step:
Access the dimension properties area in the responsive simulation bar at
the top, change the viewport resolution properties, and hit enter.
Test Data: 768px(simulating an iPad Mini in portrait mode)
Expected Result:
The viewport container constraints adapt immediately. The left-hand
application navigation panel menu automatically collapses into a compact
hamburger layout layer to conserve display real estate.
